name: Ronnec
lore: The Ronnec are a race of pre-industrial tribal xenos, infused almost seamlessly with incomprehensible bionics from their own distant future. But the Cataclysm was not content with merging a whole race's timeline into a single society and overwhelming them with miracle technology. With sudden access to the Void, the pagan gods of the Ronnec were found to be real. Now, armed with the weapons of their distant offspring and their tribal faiths made manifest, the Ronnec believe that exterminating mankind is the key to ending the Cataclysm.

rules.name: Arcane Biotek
rules.lore: Every Ronnec, at birth, is given implants to promote rapid healing and longevity, enabling recovery from fatal wounds. Soldiers thought dead by their enemies stand up again, flesh knitting itself together.
rules.text:
At the start of each Battle Round, each +Ronnec+ unit from your army restores d3 Health. Each time such a unit restores a point of Health:
* If the unit contains one or more models below their starting Health, select one of those models; that model regains one point of Health
* If all models in that unit are at their starting Health, but the unit is below its starting strength, return one destroyed model to the unit with one point of Health remaining.
* If all models in the unit are at their starting Health and the unit is at its starting strength, nothing happens.

upgrades.name: Flicker Phasing
upgrades.text: At the start of the battle, select one +Ronnec+ +Infantry+ unit per 500 points of army limit. Selected units may perform a +Scouts 3"+ movement.

upgrades.name: Projected Shield Matrix
upgrades.text: Each Battle Round, the first time a friendly +Ronnec+ unit is attacked with a ranged weapon, the unit being attacked gains a 3+ Invulnerable Save trait against all attacks from that weapon.

upgrades.name: Accelerated Recovery
upgrades.text: Whenever a +Ronnec+ unit's Arcane Biotek activates, the unit restores an additional 1 Health.
